name: Natures Generator Portable 1800-Watt Solar Generator - Power Transfer Gold Kit
description: The Nature's Generator Gold System is a great introductory package that allows you to start generating and storing your own power even if it's something you haven't done before. With the addition of the Power Transfer Kit, you'll be able to continue providing power to your most needed items without having to disconnect them from their current outlets. By installing the Power Transfer Kit you'll be able to link the existing power circuits in your indoor breaker panel to your Nature's Generator Gold System.
